channel.title: Agentic Mornings
channel.description:
Agentic Mornings — the 20-minute weekday briefing for people who build with AI.
Every weekday morning: the day's biggest AI stories, then one big idea explained properly — from first principles, with the numbers that matter: what it costs, how fast it runs, and how you know it actually works.
No hype, no hot takes. News up front, deep dive after — the stuff that matters if you ship AI products, framed the way a practitioner wants it: cost, latency, evals, and the decision you can act on.
New episodes every weekday morning.
